openrouter/router/video.description: Run any video-capable LLM with fal. Analyze, summarize, and understand video files using Gemini (Google) models. Supports mp4, mpeg, mov, webm, and YouTube links. Powered by OpenRouter.

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: This sets the upper limit for the number of tokens the model can generate in response. It won't produce more than this limit. The maximum value is the context length minus the prompt length.

max_uses.title: Max Uses
max_uses.description: Maximum number of searches the model may perform in a single request. Once reached, further search calls return an error result instead of executing. With native provider search, forwarded only to Anthropic; other native providers ignore it.

search_context_size.title: Search Context Size
search_context_size.description: How much content to retrieve per result. For Exa: low=5K, medium=15K, high=30K characters per result; when omitted, Exa picks adaptively (~2-4K per result). Ignored with native provider search. Overridden by max_characters when both are set.

max_results.title: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum results per search call (1-25). Applies to the Exa engine; ignored with native provider search. Defaults to 5.

allowed_domains.title: Allowed Domains
allowed_domains.description: Limit results to these domains. Supported by Exa and most native providers (not Google native search).

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: Search engine to use. 'auto' uses native provider search when available and falls back to Exa. 'native' prefers the provider's built-in web search (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, Perplexity), falling back to Exa for models without native support. 'exa' always uses Exa's search API.

excluded_domains.title: Excluded Domains
excluded_domains.description: Exclude results from these domains. Supported by Exa and some native providers (not OpenAI or Google native search).

max_total_results.title: Max Total Results
max_total_results.description: Maximum total results across all search calls in a single request. Useful for controlling cost and context size in agentic loops.

max_characters.title: Max Characters
max_characters.description: Exact maximum characters of content per result (1-100,000). Applies to the Exa engine; ignored with native provider search. Takes precedence over search_context_size when both are set.

anyOf.title: WebSearchUserLocation
anyOf.description:
Approximate user location to bias web search results geographically.

Only honored by native provider search; ignored by the Exa engine.
All fields are optional.

user_location.description: Approximate user location for location-biased results. Only supported by native provider search; ignored by Exa.

anyOf.title: WebSearchOptions
anyOf.description: Options for the OpenRouter ``openrouter:web_search`` server tool.

web_search_options.description: Options for web search (engine, result limits, domain filters, ...). Ignored unless enable_web_search is true.

video_urls.description: List of URLs or data URIs of video files to process. Supported formats: mp4, mpeg, mov, webm. For Google Gemini on AI Studio, YouTube links are also supported. Mutually exclusive with video_url.
video_urls.title: Video Urls

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Prompt to be used for the video processing

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: Should reasoning be the part of the final answer.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: This setting influences the variety in the model's responses. Lower values lead to more predictable and typical responses, while higher values encourage more diverse and less common responses. At 0, the model always gives the same response for a given input.

enable_web_search.title: Enable Web Search
enable_web_search.description: Give the model access to real-time web information via OpenRouter's web search server tool. When enabled, the model decides when to search and may search multiple times per request. Search costs are charged in addition to token usage.

model.title: Model
model.description: Name of the model to use. Charged based on actual token usage.

system_prompt.description: System prompt to provide context or instructions to the model
system_prompt.title: System Prompt
